title: The Whip Hero and His Party
text: As he stepped out of the conference room, my father slumped his shoulders.
“Nami and the Seven Star Heroes, huh… I’ll have to do my best.”
“That’s right.”
“Thanks to Motoyasu, we have enough combat power, but…”

My father shifted his gaze toward the people from Siltvelt with a troubled look. That’s true. In a situation where simply having a Hero as an ally grants considerable power, one must be careful about who to recruit. That’s why my Father has recruited Filolial-sama from this Motoyasu’s group. Filolial-sama is part of a safe faction that’s with me, after all. Sakura-chan seems very attached to my Father, and the other Filolial-samas also have good relationships with him.
“If I ask a man for help, I might be suspected of being gay, and if I ask a woman, there’s a risk of being attacked…”
My father muttered under his breath. Come to think of it, there are candidates among the blood relatives of the Shusaku clan’s representative and the Genmu clan’s elder.
“For now, let’s hold off on training new allies until after the wave is over.”
“Understood.”
“Eclair-san has already left to speak with the Queen of Melromarc… So for the time being, we’ll have to prepare for the usual wave and search for the missing Claw Hero.”
“According to Yuki-chan and the others, we still haven’t been able to track down his whereabouts.”

“Yeah. The people in Siltvelt are also investigating what kind of monster was disguised as the Claw Hero… There’s talk that it might be a monster that was sealed away in some other country, but since it’s a foreign nation, they can’t seem to get to the bottom of it.”
“How about I, Motoyasu, go investigate?”
“That’s a good idea. I might ask you to do that once this wave is over. After all, you were the one who took down that monster.”

It was the Beast Spear that took it down on its own, wasn’t it? It’s the spear I obtained in Filolial-sama’s sanctuary. When I grip this spear, I can faintly sense the emotions directed toward that fox monster. Presumably, this Beast Spear was forged specifically to take that creature down.
“Time for formation practice, everyone!”
“‘Yes, ma’am!’”
At the Siltvelt training grounds, Yuki-chan is leading the way, preparing for the incoming wave.
“Wow… there are so many Filolial-samas…”

My father lets out a gasp as he watches the training session for Filolial-sama, with Yuki-chan at the forefront. The Filolial-samas that I, Motoyasu, bought up are growing along nicely. It’s already getting a bit cramped in the castle gardens.
“Aren’t they getting in the way of the castle folk’s training…?”
“What are you saying? Yuki-chan and the others are excellent Filolial-sama.”

Siltvelt soldiers are mixed in among Yuki-chan’s training partners. Since they’re not human, they transform into beasts and make tricky moves. Come to think of it… there were shape-shifting Demi-Humans in my Father’s village, too. I recall a dog that turned into a pig. They were quite fond of the meals that Father cooked.
“If the formations seem to be coming together smoothly, the next wave shouldn’t be a problem.”
“That’s right!”
And so, preparations for the wave progressed steadily. I heard that that night, Father was organizing the personnel who would face the wave.
The next day… We could see an airship flying toward us in the sky. There were also other things flying that looked like airplanes.
“Huh, so this world has airplanes? Could it be that the Seven Star Heroes, who oversee Shieldfreeden and Faubrey, are on board that one?”
“That is what we’ve been told.”

While soldiers riding flying dragons kept watch in the sky, the airship docked in the square near the castle. People began streaming out of the airship, and things gradually got noisier. After that, my Father and I were asked to wait in the castle’s throne room for an audience.
“What kind of person is the Seven-Star Hero?”
“He’s said to be a genius. The story goes that he mastered Magic from a young age and revolutionized papermaking techniques.”
The leader of the Shusaku clan was explaining this to my Father. I, too, began to recall bits and pieces. But I can only remember the basics of his background.
“Also, um… I’ve heard he devoted himself to recreating vehicles said to have existed in the past.”
“Huh… There really are some amazing people out there. Well, if heroes are summoned regularly, it wouldn’t be surprising if they built airships or airplanes.”
“Though it’s not exactly a difficult mode of transportation if you have flying dragons.”
The leader of the Shusaku clan muttered under his breath.
“Well, maybe so. From a cost perspective, it might actually be cheaper in this world to leave it to dragons or the like.”
Perhaps sensing his counterpart’s thoughts, Father continued.
“It can carry a lot of people—isn’t that a dream? Flying airships in a different world, I mean.”
“As commanded by the Shield Hero.”
The leader of the Shusaku clan saluted.
“Then, from this day forward, our nation shall promote research into flight technology.”
“That’s not what I meant… Ah… I’ve done it now.”
My Father is muttering to himself that he’s put his foot in his mouth.
“The Whip Hero has arrived!”
A soldier called out, and the doors to the throne room swung open as the Seven Star Heroes entered. …This time, the Beast Spear isn’t reacting. With a light, brisk stride, a man approached.

He’s quite handsome, isn’t he? A man with blond hair and blue eyes—he has a certain resemblance to Filo-tan. He’s wearing a jacket and denim pants; his sense of style isn’t bad. Though he does look a bit out of place, I believe this sort of fashion is actually in style in Faubrey.
“My name is Takt Alsaholn Faubrey, the Whip Hero. It’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance.”
The Whip Hero knelt on one knee, bowed his head as if saluting, and greeted us, accompanied by several pigs who appeared to be his attendants.
“Oink!”
Behind him, a pig with dragon-like horns was saying something.
“To think that a representative from Shieldfreeden would come to our country… Siltvelt will welcome the Hero’s party to the best of our ability,”
said the chief of the Shusaku clan, appearing to extend a warm welcome on the surface.
“We are truly honored… and… without further ado, I’d like to request an audience with the Hero of your country…”
After saying that, the Whip Hero turned his gaze toward me and my Father. Reading the room, my father stepped forward.
“I am Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero. It’s a pleasure to meet you.”
I figured I should follow suit. Stepping forward as well, I said with a slight salute:
“I am Motoyasu Kitamura, The Love Hunter!”
“Motoyasu, you never miss a beat. Um, he’s the Spear Hero. He’s a bit eccentric, but he’s very strong, so you can count on him.”
“…Understood. Nice to meet you.”
The Hero of the Whip paused for a moment before nodding. His gaze seems a bit suspicious, though.
“Was it you who brought that airship back? That’s amazing—to think there’s an airship in another world.”
“Ah… it’s not that difficult. Generating the fuel is a hassle, though.”

Once the introductions were over, the Hero of the Whip announced in a somewhat brusque manner. My father looks slightly disappointed by that response. It seems it wasn’t quite the answer he was expecting.
“So? I want to investigate that monster—or rather, that demon—that was disguised as the Claw Hero before the waves hit. Is that okay?”

The leader of the Shusaku clan looks a bit displeased by the arrogant tone, but since the other party is a hero from another country with apparently noble blood, he can’t treat him too roughly. With a look of reluctance, he orders his subordinates.
“Then this way.”
“Should we come along too?”
When Father asks, the Hero of the Whip glares at us with a sidelong glance.
“There’s no need to worry about it. It’s not serious enough to trouble the Four Holy Heroes.”
“R-really…?”

Those pigs are carrying firearms, and it gives me a really unpleasant feeling. I wonder what it is. I’m haunted by this nasty sensation—something I feel like I should remember but just can’t quite place. What would happen if I took them out with a preemptive strike? I’d probably get scolded by my Father, so I’ll hold back from attacking without a good reason.
“By the way, who was it that took down that impostor pretending to be a Hero…?”
“It was me.”
